# Text Emphasis

## Bold

**This is bold text**

**Multiple words in bold**

## Italic

*This is italic text*

*Single word italic*

***Combined bold and italic***

## Strikethrough

This paragraph has **bold**, *italic*, and ~~strikethrough~~ mixed together.

> spanning multiple lines
